name: Nidec Corporation
blurb: Nidec Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of electric motors, drives, and related components. It is the world's leading producer of small precision motors for hard disk drives, and also supplies motors for automotive, home appliance, and industrial applications. The company has a strong global market position, particularly in brushless DC motors and automotive electrification components.
recent: In the past 30 days, Nidec's stock has been volatile following news of an accounting probe that caused a 22% plunge in September 2025. A Morningstar report in April 2026 downgraded the company's capital allocation rating to 'Poor' based on a third-party report. As of May 7, 2026, the stock closed at ¥2,593, up 8.13% on the day, with a 52-week range of ¥1,797 to ¥3,296.
